title: Report parallel coordination cost on fan-out
narrative: Nubble compares wall-clock critical path, duplicated context, and fan-in review cost so parallelism is measured rather than assumed beneficial. Accepts WalkingLabs L14 and P08 guidance[^wl-l14-coord][^wl-p08-coord].
implementation: `CoordinationCostMetrics` and `summarize_coordination_cost` in `mechaharness.coordination_cost` report fan-out orchestration cost.
